ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus) DLL side-loading via vendor-signed binary executed from user-writable path
ucs.description: Detects APT32's signature execution pattern documented across Cybereason 'Operation Cobalt Kitty', ESET, FireEye and Volexity reports: a legitimately-signed binary from a major security/productivity vendor (Symantec, McAfee, Google, Microsoft, Kaspersky, Adobe) is dropped into AppData, Temp, ProgramData or Users\Public and executed there in order to side-load a malicious DLL co-located in the same directory. Signed vendor binaries should never run from user-writable paths — this trips on the first stage of every documented OceanLotus implant chain (Denis, KerrDown, SOUNDBITE, Cobalt Strike bea
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\Public\\*") AND Processes.process_company IN ("Symantec Corporation","McAfee, Inc.","McAfee LLC","Google LLC","Google Inc.","Microsoft Corporation","Kaspersky Lab","Avast Software s.r.o.","Bitdefender SRL","Adobe Inc.","Adobe Systems Incorporated") AND NOT (Processes.user="*$" OR Processes.user IN ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")) by host, user, Processes.process_name, Processes.process_company, Processes.process_path, Processes.process_hash, Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | where count < 50
ucs.kql:
let SuspectParents = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\")
    | where ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName in~ (
        "Symantec Corporation","McAfee, Inc.","McAfee LLC",
        "Google LLC","Google Inc.","Microsoft Corporation",
        "Kaspersky Lab","Avast Software s.r.o.","Bitdefender SRL",
        "Adobe Inc.","Adobe Systems Incorporated")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
       and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
    | project ParentTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              SignedBinary = FileName, BinaryVendor = ProcessVersionInfoCompanyName,
              BinaryPath = FolderPath, SignedPid = ProcessId,
              SignedSha = SHA256, ParentLauncher = InitiatingProcessFileName;
DeviceImageLoadEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName endswith ".dll"
| where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
   and FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
| join kind=inner SuspectParents on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.SignedPid
| where FolderPath =~ BinaryPath
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, BinaryVendor,
          SignedBinary, BinaryPath, SignedSha,
          ParentLauncher,
          SideLoadedDll = FileName, SideLoadedSha = SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where TargetProcessName has_any (@"\AppData\Roaming\", @"\AppData\Local\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Users\Public\")
| where TargetProcessFileCompany in~ (
    "Symantec Corporation","McAfee, Inc.","McAfee LLC",
    "Google LLC","Google Inc.","Microsoft Corporation",
    "Kaspersky Lab","Avast Software s.r.o.","Bitdefender SRL",
    "Adobe Inc.","Adobe Systems Incorporated")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where TargetProcessName !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
   and TargetProcessName !startswith @"C:\Windows\"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          SignedBinary = TargetProcessName,
          BinaryVendor = TargetProcessFileCompany,
          TargetProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcessName,
          BinarySha = SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AppData\Roaming\* OR *\appdata\roaming\* OR *\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\appdata\local\temp\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\*) @Image:(*\rastlsc.exe OR *\RasTlsc.exe OR *\RASTLSC.EXE OR *\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\McOemCpy.exe OR *\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\googleupdate.exe OR *\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\WSC_Proxy.exe OR *\cliconfg.exe OR *\CliConfg.exe OR *\rekeywiz.exe OR *\REKEYWIZ.EXE OR *\GupdateService.exe OR *\flashutil.exe OR *\FlashUtil.exe OR *\msoia.exe OR *\MsoIA.exe OR *\AcroRd32.exe OR *\AdobeARM.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(Users\\[^\\]+\\AppData\\(Roaming|Local\\Temp)|ProgramData|Users\\Public)\\/i ImageFileName=/\\(rastlsc|mcoemcpy|GoogleUpdate|wsc_proxy|cliconfg|rekeywiz|GupdateService|flashutil|msoia|AcroRd32|AdobeARM|VeraCrypt)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, SHA256HashData, ParentBaseFileName], function={count() as Hits | min(_time) as FirstSeen | max(_time) as LastSeen})
| Hits < 50
ucs.rationale: Side-loading from user-writable paths is APT32's tier-1 fingerprint, not a generic technique. ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 OceanLotus Office macro → rundll32 / regsvr32 / mshta CactusTorch-style loader chain
ucs.description: Detects Microsoft Office applications (winword, excel, powerpnt, outlook) spawning rundll32.exe, regsvr32.exe or mshta.exe with command-line arguments referencing user-writable paths (AppData/Temp/ProgramData/Public), remote scriptlet URLs, or .sct/.hta payloads — the canonical APT32 Cobalt Kitty / CactusTorch initial-execution chain that delivers in-memory Cobalt Strike Beacon or Denis/KerrDown loaders.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","mspub.exe","visio.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe") AND (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Users\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*http://*" OR Processes.process="*https://*" OR Processes.process="*.sct*" OR Processes.process="*.hta*" OR Processes.process="*scrobj.dll*" OR Processes.process="*javascript:*" OR Processes.process="*vbscript:*") AND NOT Processes.user="*$" by host, user, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_name, Processes.process, Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (
    "winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe",
    "mspub.exe","visio.exe")
| where FileName in~ (
    "rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe",
    "wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (
    @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\",
    @"\Users\Public\", "http://", "https://",
    ".sct", ".hta", "scrobj.dll",
    "javascript:", "vbscript:", "DllRegisterServer")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          OfficeApp = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          OfficeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          OfficeAccount = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          Loader = FileName,
          LoaderCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          LoaderSha = SHA256,
          IsRemoteSession = isnotempty(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any (
    @"\winword.exe",@"\excel.exe",@"\powerpnt.exe",
    @"\outlook.exe",@"\mspub.exe",@"\visio.exe")
| where TargetProcessName has_any (
    @"\rundll32.exe",@"\regsvr32.exe",@"\mshta.exe",
    @"\wscript.exe",@"\cscript.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (
    @"\AppData\",@"\Temp\",@"\ProgramData\",
    @"\Users\Public\","http://","https://",
    ".sct",".hta","scrobj.dll",
    "javascript:","vbscript:","DllRegisterServer")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Office Loader via rundll32/regsvr32/mshta
id: a4f1c9e7-3b2d-4d4a-9c12-c0balt-kitty32
status: experimental
description: Detects Microsoft Office applications spawning rundll32/regsvr32/mshta/wscript/cscript with arguments referencing user-writable paths, remote URLs, or scriptlet/HTA payloads — the canonical APT32 (OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty) initial execution chain documented by Cybereason, ESET, and FireEye.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2018/03/13/oceanlotus-ships-new-backdoor/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1059.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\mspub.exe'
      - '\visio.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
  selection_args:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
      - '.sct'
      - '.hta'
      - 'scrobj.dll'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
      - 'DllRegisterServer'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_args and not filter_machine_account
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Office add-ins or COM extensions calling rundll32 against vendor DLLs in Program Files (excluded by path predicate)
  - Approved internal templates that fetch resources via HTTPS (rare; review by URL allowlist)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\winword.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\mspub.exe OR *\MSPUB.EXE OR *\visio.exe OR *\VISIO.EXE) @Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\CSCRIPT.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\AppData\* OR *\appdata\* OR *\Temp\* OR *\temp\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\programdata\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\users\public\* OR *http* OR *.sct* OR *.hta* OR *scrobj.dll* OR *scrobj.Dll* OR *javascript\:* OR *vbscript\:* OR *DllRegisterServer*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|mspub|visio)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|wscript|cscript)\.exe$/i
| UserName!=/\$$/
| regex("(?i)(\\\\AppData\\\\|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\ProgramData\\\\|\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\|https?:|\\.sct|\\.hta|scrobj\\.dll|javascript:|vbscript:|DllRegisterServer)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function={min(_time) as FirstSeen | max(_time) as LastSeen | count() as Hits})
ucs.rationale: Office-spawned rundll32/regsvr32/mshta on its own is noisy (legitimate add-ins use rundll32 against signed DLLs in Program Files); APT32-specific tradecraft is the AppData/Temp/ProgramData payload path or the remote .sct/.hta scriptlet URL. Cybereason's 'Operation Cobalt Kitty' (2017) documents APT32 macros invoking `rundll32.exe %APPDATA%\…\<file>.dll,Setting` and `regsvr32 /s /n /u /i:http://…/f
